text.ms:
1. (1) Perintah ini bolehlah dinamakan Perintah Duti Hiburan (Pengecualian)

(No. 3) 2022.

(2) Perintah ini disifatkan telah mula berkuat kuasa pada 1 Januari 2022.

Pengecualian

2. Tiket masuk bagi tayangan filem-filem dengan tajuk yang dinyatakan dalam

Jadual yang telah ditayangkan di Dadi Cinema di dalam Wilayah Persekutuan

Kuala Lumpur dalam tempoh mulai 1 Januari 2022 hingga 31 Julai 2022 dikecualikan

daripada duti hiburan.

 TENGKU DATUK SERI UTAMA ZAFRUL BIN TENGKU ABDUL AZIZ

 Menteri Kewangan

ENTERTAINMENTS DUTY ACT 1953

ENTERTAINMENTS DUTY (EXEMPTION) (NO. 3) ORDER 2022

IN exercise of the powers conferred by paragraph 12(1)(b) of the

Entertainments Duty Act 1953 [Act 103], the Minister makes the following order:

Citation and commencement

1. (1) This order may be cited as the Entertainments Duty (Exemption) (No. 3)

Order 2022.

(2) This Order is deemed to have come into operation on 1 January 2022.

Exemption

2. The admission ticket for the screening of the movies with the title specified

in the Schedule which were screened at the Dadi Cinema in the Federal Territory of

Kuala Lumpur within the period from 1 January 2022 until 31 July 2022 are exempted

from entertainments duty.
